title: WM60005: Climate Impact On Water Resources
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Introduction to weather and climate. Physics of climate. Impact of climate on
environment. El-Nino, La-Lina, IOD (Indian Ocean Dipole), NAO (North Atlantic
Oscillation), Arctic Oscillation, Indian Summer Monsoon. Precipitation and
temperature change due to climate variations. Generation of extreme events.
Water bodies on the earth and their variations due to change of climate.
Relations among climate, vegetation and water.
